name: Spooky Stable
author: YOUR NAME
tagline: eight silly unicorn toys for little hands
description: A no-menu, no-text toy for a three-year-old. Eight buttons pick a toy starring a rainbow unicorn: fart, poop, pee, burp, sneeze, a drum jam, a toilet flush and a booger flick. Every key makes it act at once with cartoon squash and stretch, shake and particles; every note snaps to the mood's scale, and one knob changes the whole world's colours and music.
